function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for what you cannot already know: what changed, what is recent, or the present state of a named person, product or organisation. Returns text; for pictures or clips use show_pictures. Not for settled knowledge (definitions, translations, history, arithmetic) and never to double check what you know: answer those yourself.

query.description: What to look up, as you would type it into a search box
